# The NCA Hub

> Strategic NCA exam preparation for internationally trained lawyers qualifying in Canada.

The NCA Hub provides study notes (under 80 pages per subject), answer templates, readiness assessments, and free guides for candidates sitting NCA challenge exams. Built by Kartik Kumar — an Indian-qualified lawyer who worked at UK law firms DWF, Eversheds Sutherland, and Keoghs, and who passed 4 NCA subjects in under 4 months.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://www.thencahub.com/
- Free Guides: https://www.thencahub.com/blog/
- About the Founder: https://www.thencahub.com/about/
